Question: I know a lady who wants to revert to Islam after being informed about the truth of the religion and Prophet Mohammad (peace be upon him). She wants to change her name to have a Muslim name. She wants to have a name which means "Allah's chosen one" as she feels Allah has chosen her be on the true path. I request you to please provide such a name(s) for the lady. Answer ID: 12334 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 675/675=M/1430) Choose any of the below mentioned names: Aasiya ( آسیہ ), Maryam ( مریم ), Safiyyah ( صفیہ ), Ruqayyah ( رقیہ ) etc Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
